title: What's New: Entering and Approving Time Sheets (2024 release wave 1)

Copying time sheets and details factbox

Time submission policy for empty lines

features.name: New time sheet tile in self-service
features.description: A new tile in self-service role centers that takes users directly to their current time sheet based on the work date, and a separate tile for new time sheets with no lines started.

features.name: Context-aware submit and reopen actions
features.description: Submit and reopen actions are now context-aware to prevent errors from being thrown when they shouldn't be, avoiding unnecessary error situations.

features.name: Conditional formatting for status column
features.description: The status column on time sheet lines uses conditional formatting to display in red and italic when required data is missing, making it easier to spot what needs to be entered.

features.name: Dynamic column visibility based on setup
features.description: Columns in time sheet lines such as project, project task, cause of absence, and chargeable are now dynamically shown or hidden based on the company's setup to reduce clutter and improve readability.
caveats: Columns are dependent on company configuration

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts for copying time sheet values
features.description: Users can now use keyboard shortcuts like F8 to easily copy values from the previous time sheet line, improving data entry efficiency.

features.name: Enhanced time sheet copy functionality
features.description: Extended capability to copy time sheet lines from previous time sheets with options to select from open or submitted time sheets and pick specific lines to copy.
caveats: Can copy from open or submitted time sheets

features.name: Time sheet line details factbox
features.description: A details factbox is now available in all places where time sheet lines are shown, allowing users to view data and comments related to the resource, project, or tasks.

features.name: Time submission policy
features.description: A new time submission policy allows setup to control whether empty lines in time sheets should be skipped during submission or kept with warnings, maintaining backwards compatibility.
caveats: Backwards compatibility maintained with existing behavior option

features.name: Enhanced manager time sheet details for projects
features.description: Manager time sheets by projects now display additional details including resource number, resource name, weekend work columns, totals per line, and comments from both header and lines.
caveats: Some fields can be added through personalization

features.name: Selective time sheet approval by default
features.description: Changed the default behavior when approving time sheets so that only the selected time sheets are approved by default, reducing errors and turnaround time.
